165: func (gm *DynamicGuardrailManager) ValidateResourceUsage(nodeID string, metrics map[string]interface{}) (*GuardrailViolation, bool) {
166: 	gm.mu.RLock()
167: 	defer gm.mu.RUnlock()
168: 
169: 	violations := make([]*GuardrailViolation, 0)
170: 
171: 	for guardrailType, config := range gm.configurations {
172: 		if !config.Enabled {
173: 			continue
174: 		}
175: 
176: 		if !gm.isNodeScope(guardrailType, nodeID) {
177: 			continue
178: 		}
179: 
180: 		if gm.isInCooldown(guardrailType) {
181: 			continue
182: 		}
183: 
184: 		var value float64
185: 		switch config.Type {
186: 		case GuardrailTypeMemory:
187: 			if mem, ok := metrics["memory_usage"].(float64); ok {
188: 				value = mem
189: 			}
190: 		case GuardrailTypeCPU:
191: 			if cpu, ok := metrics["cpu_usage"].(float64); ok {
192: 				value = cpu
193: 			}
194: 		case GuardrailTypeNetwork:
195: 			if net, ok := metrics["network_bandwidth"].(float64); ok {
196: 				value = net
197: 			}
198: 		}
199: 
200: 		if value > config.MaxValue && config.MaxValue > 0 {
201: 			violation := &GuardrailViolation{
202: 				ID:            uuid.New().String(),
203: 				NodeID:        nodeID,
204: 				GuardrailType: config.Type,
205: 				ViolationType: "resource_exceeded",
206: 				Message:       fmt.Sprintf("%s usage %.2f exceeds max %.2f", config.Type, value, config.MaxValue),
207: 				Severity:      gm.determineSeverity(config.Type, value, config.MaxValue),
208: 				Context:       metrics,
209: 				Timestamp:     time.Now(),
210: 			}
211: 			violations = append(violations, violation)
212: 			gm.setCooldown(guardrailType, config.Cooldown)
213: 		}
214: 	}
215: 
216: 	if len(violations) > 0 {
217: 		highest := violations[0]
218: 		for _, v := range violations[1:] {
219: 			if gm.severityOrder(v.Severity) > gm.severityOrder(highest.Severity) {
220: 				highest = v
221: 			}
222: 		}
223: 		return highest, true
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	return nil, false
227: }

660: func (pe *PolicyEngine) EvaluateAction(nodeID, action string, context map[string]interface{}) (bool, string) {
661: 	pe.mu.RLock()
662: 	defer pe.mu.RUnlock()
663: 
664: 	var applicablePolicies []*Policy
665: 	for _, policy := range pe.activePolicies {
666: 		if !policy.Enabled {
667: 			continue
668: 		}
669: 		applicablePolicies = append(applicablePolicies, policy)
670: 	}
671: 
672: 	for _, policy := range applicablePolicies {
673: 		for _, rule := range policy.Rules {
674: 			if pe.matchesCondition(rule.Condition, context) {
675: 				if rule.Action == "deny" {
676: 					return false, fmt.Sprintf("denied by policy '%s' rule '%s'", policy.Name, rule.ID)
677: 				}
678: 				if rule.Action == "warn" {
679: 					return true, fmt.Sprintf("warning from policy '%s'", policy.Name)
680: 				}
681: 			}
682: 		}
683: 	}
684: 
685: 	return true, "allowed"
686: }

688: func (pe *PolicyEngine) matchesCondition(condition map[string]interface{}, context map[string]interface{}) bool {
689: 	if condition == nil {
690: 		return true
691: 	}
692: 
693: 	for key, expected := range condition {
694: 		actual, ok := context[key]
695: 		if !ok {
696: 			return false
697: 		}
698: 
699: 		switch exp := expected.(type) {
700: 		case float64:
701: 			if act, ok := actual.(float64); ok {
702: 				if act < exp {
703: 					return false
704: 				}
705: 			}
706: 		case string:
707: 			if act, ok := actual.(string); ok {
708: 				if act != exp {
709: 					return false
710: 				}
711: 			}
712: 		case bool:
713: 			if act, ok := actual.(bool); ok {
714: 				if act != exp {
715: 					return false
716: 				}
717: 			}
718: 		}
719: 	}
720: 
721: 	return true
722: }

724: func (pe *PolicyEngine) CommitPolicyToBlockchain(policyID string) (string, error) {
725: 	pe.mu.RLock()
726: 	policy, ok := pe.activePolicies[policyID]
727: 	pe.mu.RUnlock()
728: 
729: 	if !ok {
730: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("policy not found: %s", policyID)
731: 	}
732: 
733: 	if pe.validationChainClient == nil {
734: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("validation chain client not configured")
735: 	}
736: 
737: 	rules := make(map[string]interface{}, len(policy.Rules))
738: 	for _, rule := range policy.Rules {
739: 		if rule == nil {
740: 			continue
741: 		}
742: 		rules[rule.ID] = map[string]interface{}{
743: 			"type":       rule.Type,
744: 			"condition":  rule.Condition,
745: 			"action":     rule.Action,
746: 			"parameters": rule.Parameters,
747: 		}
748: 	}
749: 
750: 	txHash, err := pe.validationChainClient.CommitPolicy(validationchain.PolicyCommitRequest{
751: 		Name:     policy.Name,
752: 		Type:     "guardrail_policy",
753: 		Priority: policy.Priority,
754: 		Enabled:  policy.Enabled,
755: 		Rules:    rules,
756: 	})
757: 	if err != nil {
758: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to commit policy to validation chain: %w", err)
759: 	}
760: 
761: 	policyData, err := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{
762: 		"policy":          policy,
763: 		"validation_hash": txHash,
764: 		"committed_at":    time.Now().UTC(),
765: 	})
766: 	if err != nil {
767: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal committed policy record: %w", err)
768: 	}
769: 
770: 	if err := pe.db.Transaction(func(tx *buntdb.Tx) error {
771: 		_, _, err = tx.Set(fmt.Sprintf("policy:committed:%s", policyID), string(policyData), nil)
772: 		return err
773: 	}); err != nil {
774: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to persist committed policy: %w", err)
775: 	}
776: 
777: 	log.Printf("Policy %s committed to validation chain with tx hash: %s", policyID, txHash)

```go
	gm.violations[violation.ID] = violation

	if gm.db == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return gm.db.Transaction(func(tx *buntdb.Tx) error {
		data, err := json.Marshal(violation)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, _, err = tx.Set(fmt.Sprintf("guardrail:violation:%s", violation.ID), string(data), nil)
		return err
	})
}
```

This method:
1. Acquires a write lock.
2. Stores the violation in the in-memory `violations` map (keyed by violation ID).
3. If a BuntDB database is configured, it persists the violation under the key `guardrail:violation:<UUID>`.
